description.en: The ID of the cloud desktop.
The end of the time range to query.
The ID of the end user.
The name of the recording file.

description.zh:
排序字段，若不指定则按照录屏开始时间倒序。
- startTime ： 录屏开始时间。
description.en:
The sorting basis. If you do not specify this parameter, the results are sorted by screen recording start time in descending order. Valid value:

- `startTime`: the start time of a screen recording.

description.zh:
排序方向。
- asc :  正序。
- desc : 倒序。
description.en:
The sorting order. Valid values:

- `asc`: ascending

- `desc`: descending

description.zh: 分页查询时，每页最大行数。
description.en: The number of entries per page.

description.zh:
录屏文件类型。
- alltime : 全程录屏。
- period : 间隔录屏。
- event ：时间录屏。
- session ： 会话录屏。
description.en:
The type of the screen recording. Valid values:

- `alltime`: full-time recording

- `period`: recording at intervals

- `event`: event-triggered recording

- `session`: session-based recording

description.zh: 地域ID。可以调用[DescribeRegions](~~DescribeRegions~~)获取无影云电脑支持的地域列表。
description.en: The region ID. You can call the [DescribeRegions](~~DescribeRegions~~) operation to query the regions that are supported by Elastic Desktop Service.
The beginning of the time range to query.

description.zh:
录屏文件状态。
- 0 ：上传成功。
- 1 ：上传中。
description.en:
The status of the screen recording file. Valid values:

- `0`: The file is uploaded.

- `1`: The file is being uploaded.

title.zh: 查询全地域录屏文件列表
title.en: Query the list of screen recording files across all regions
